title: Marketplace Orders Replacement Programme Settings
content:
Whether a free replacement can be shipped instead of a refund on a Marketplace Orders order depends on its delivery option. The table gives, per option, whether replacements are offered, the replacement request window, the maximum number of replacements per order, and the unreturned replacement days: the calendar days after a replacement ships by which the original item must receive its first carrier scan.

| Delivery option | Replacement offered | Replacement request window (calendar days after delivery) | Maximum replacements per order | Unreturned replacement days |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Seller Fulfilled Standard Shipping | No | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Seller Fulfilled Expedited Shipping | No | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Standard | Yes | 30 | 1 | 30 |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day | Yes | 30 | 1 | 30 |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day | Yes | 30 | 1 | 30 |
| Large Item Freight Delivery | No | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |

## Points of reading

- Only the three Fulfilled by Northloop options offer replacements; on the other three every replacement figure is not applicable.
- On an option that offers replacements, no more than 1 replacement is shipped against one order.
- The replacement request window and the unreturned replacement days are both 30 calendar days, but they run from different dates: the request window from the delivered date, the unreturned replacement days from the day the replacement ships.

### Hypothetical reading

For a hypothetical replacement shipped on 4 May on Fulfilled by Northloop Standard, the 30 unreturned replacement days end on 3 June. The date is an example input.
